buildr/page.label: Page
buildr/page.description: The root of a document. Everything else lives inside it.

emptySlotText.default: Add a section to start the page

buildr/section.label: Section
buildr/section.description: A band of the page: a landmark or a plain wrapper, with an optional background image.

buildr/container.label: Container
buildr/container.description: Keeps its content to a readable width, centred.

buildr/stack.label: Stack
buildr/stack.description: Lays its children out in a row or a column.

buildr/grid.label: Grid
buildr/grid.description: Lays its children out in columns.

buildr/heading.label: Heading
buildr/heading.description: A title. Its level is the outline; its look is a style.

buildr/text.label: Text
buildr/text.description: A paragraph or a short piece of text.

buildr/rich-text.label: Rich text
buildr/rich-text.description: Formatted content: headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes and links.

buildr/button.label: Button
buildr/button.description: A button, or a link that looks like one.

buildr/badge.label: Badge
buildr/badge.description: A short status or category label.

buildr/card.label: Card
buildr/card.description: A boxed piece of content with media, text and actions.

buildr/accordion.label: Accordion
buildr/accordion.description: Expandable sections, such as a list of questions and answers.

buildr/loop.label: Loop
buildr/loop.description: Repeats a template for every entry of a list or a collection.

emptySlotText.item: Design one item: it is repeated for every entry
emptySlotText.empty: What to show when there is nothing to list

buildr/pagination.label: Pagination
buildr/pagination.description: Links to the pages of a listing.

buildr/form.label: Form
buildr/form.description: A form whose submissions are collected by the site.

emptySlotText.default: Add fields and a submit button
